hebrewText: פֶּן תֶּאֱלַ֥ף ארחת/ו אֹֽרְחֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֖ מוֹקֵ֣שׁ לְ/נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ

hence, to learn (and causatively to teach)

tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: a noose (for catching animals) (literally or figuratively); by implication, a hook (for the nose)
properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
